attempts.raw_response: {"category":"coding-development","confidence":0.96,"evidence":[{"fact":"首次点击会进入确认状态，5秒内再次点击才执行重启。","paragraph_id":"p31s1"},{"fact":"客户端组件在启动时建立基线，因此按钮只会在下一次启动后出现，此后即可用于重启。","paragraph_id":"p26s2"},{"fact":"插件提供一个明确的POST重启路由，并在创建任何辅助进程前执行限制检查。","paragraph_id":"p38s1"}],"id":"gh:1371289249","insufficient_evidence":false,"limitations":["检测到systemd监管且未启用allowRestart时会拒绝重启。","检测到调试器附加时不允许重启。","辅助进程脱离原进程且不再受插件控制；特殊包装启动方式无法完整复现。","Host不含端口时，辅助进程仅等待1.5秒后启动替代进程。"],"summary_zh":"为DSH网页配置新增重启功能：二次确认后重启dsh web，页面短暂断开并在替代进程监听后重连。首次安装后仍需从终端手动重启一次。","tags":["DSH插件","进程重启","开发工具","网页配置"]}

{"metadata":{"description":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds one row to Settings → General: a button that restarts the running dsh web process with the same invocation it was started with.","id":"gh:1371289249","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-simple-restart","slug":"yizhixiaokong/dsh-simple-restart","topics":["dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-market","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds one row to Settings → General: a button that restarts the runnin"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"g dsh web process with the same invocation it was started with."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-simple-restart"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin
that adds one row to **Settings → General**: a button that restarts the ru"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"nning
`dsh web` process with the same invocation it was started with."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It exists because a plugin change to a client bundle only takes effect after the
host restarts, and "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"doing that from a terminal means finding the terminal again.
This package owns its own route and its"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" own restart logic — no other plugin is
involved."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The row in Settings → General."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"A second click within 5s confirms; the hint line then reports the host pid
stepping aside and the he"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ick within 5s confirms; the hint line then reports the host pid
stepping aside and the helper's pid."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"1. The row asks this package's own host route for a restart (a second click
confirms; the armed stat"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"e expires after 5s).
2. The host checks its own safety rules, then spawns a **detached helper** and
"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"hands it the exact boot invocation — executable, argv, working directory.
3. The helper waits until "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"the listening port is free, starts the replacement,
and then watches for up to 20s to confirm it bou"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"nd the port.
4. The host exits 500ms after the handoff. The browser page disconnects briefly
and rec"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"onnects when the new process is up."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"If anything goes wrong after the handoff, the helper writes a diagnosis to
`$TMPDIR/dsh-simple-resta"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"rt-<timestamp>.err.log` (the replacement's own stdout/stderr
go to the `.out.log` beside it). The pr"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ocess that would otherwise log the
failure is the one that just exited — that is why the helper is a"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" separate
program rather than a `setTimeout` in the host."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Why a helper at all"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"A process cannot replace itself: it can only stop, and something has to start the
successor *after* "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"the listening port is free. Starting it earlier dies with
`EADDRINUSE`. So the restart is a handshak"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"e between two processes, and the second
one has to be detached — it must outlive the first."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"`"free"` is tested by *connecting* to the port, never by binding it: a test bind
would itself hold t"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"he port at the exact moment the replacement needs it."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Requirement | Notes |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| DSH, web profile | The route is served by `webServer`; the settings row is a client-half slot. |
|"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" Same-origin loopback caller | The route refuses anything else (see below). |
| Not supervised by sy"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"stemd — or `allowRestart: true` | systemd's default `KillMode=control-group` kills the helper togeth"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"er with the unit, so a restart there would leave nothing running. |
| Not under a debugger | A debug"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"ger attached to this process cannot follow it across an `exec`-less restart. |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Straight from GitHub — nothing to clone (pin a tag if you want a fixed release):"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"From a clone, when you want to edit the code:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"From npm:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"All three end the same way, and none of them needs a manual registration step:
`dsh plugin` runs pnp"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"m, then reads each installed dependency's
`package.json`; a package that declares `dsh.bundle` has i"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ts name appended to
`dsh.profile.bundles`, which is what mounts the
`cordis.patch.yml` beside it."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"**Now restart `dsh web` once from a terminal** — the client bundle is baselined
at boot, so the butt"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"on appears only after the next start. After that, the
button can do it."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"To remove it:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Settings → **通用 / General** → *重启 dsh web*:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- first click arms the button (`确认重启？`), a second click within 5s performs it;
- the hint line then "},{"id":"p31s2","text":"shows the host pid that is stepping aside and the helper's
pid, plus the diagnostics path;
- the pag"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"e reconnects on its own once the replacement is listening."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"The row's config is passed to the host `apply`:"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"| `allowRestart` | `boolean` | `false` under a detected systemd supervisor, `true` otherwise | Wheth"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"er a restart is permitted where supervision was detected. Only set this where the unit is known to s"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"urvive it (`KillMode=process`, or a supervisor that restarts the unit). |"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## HTTP API"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"One exact route, `POST /dsh-simple-restart/api/restart`. It is fenced before anything is
spawned:"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"| Check | Refusal |"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"| Method other than POST | `405` with `Allow: POST` |
| Socket peer that is not `127.0.0.1`, `::1` o"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"r `::ffff:127.0.0.1` | `403` |
| Any forwarding header (`forwarded`, `x-forwarded-for`, `x-real-ip`)"},{"id":"p40s3","text":" | `403` |
| Missing `Origin`, or an `Origin` whose host is not `Host` | `403` |
| systemd superviso"},{"id":"p40s4","text":"r detected and `allowRestart` not `true` | `403` |
| Debugger detected in `process.execArgv` | `403`"},{"id":"p40s5","text":" |
| A restart is already scheduled | `409` |"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"Failures answer `{"ok":false,"error":"…"}` with the status from the table above."},{"id":"p43s1","text":"The helper is spawned as `node -e <program>`, detached with `stdio: "ignore"` and
`unref()`ed, so it"},{"id":"p43s2","text":" is out of this process's lifetime from the moment it exists.
It is given the boot invocation as dat"},{"id":"p43s3","text":"a (`{ file, args, cwd }`), never by
re-running a shell command line: when the host was started as `n"},{"id":"p43s4","text":"ode …/bin.js`
the absolute entry and its original `execArgv`/argv are reused; otherwise it
falls bac"},{"id":"p43s5","text":"k to the `dsh` executable on `PATH` with the original arguments."},{"id":"p44s1","text":"## Limits and known behaviour"},{"id":"p45s1","text":"- **Detached, not supervised.** Once the helper is running, this package has no
further control over"},{"id":"p45s2","text":" it. A restart of a process started with unusual wrapper
arguments (a shell function, a container en"},{"id":"p45s3","text":"trypoint) falls back to running
`dsh` with the same argv — which is right for `dsh web`, not for eve"},{"id":"p45s4","text":"ry
possible wrapper.
- **No port to wait for.** If `Host` carries no port, the helper simply waits
1"},{"id":"p45s5","text":".5s before starting the replacement.
- **Environment is inherited**, including the current working d"},{"id":"p45s6","text":"irectory.
- **Diagnostics live in the temp directory** and are never cleaned up; they are
small, and"},{"id":"p45s7","text":" finding them is the point."}],"truncated":true}
